blocks.text: SAN FRANCISCO, Agusan del Sur — Dengue transmission in this commercial hub is showing signs of slowing down, though local health officials warned residents not to let their guard down as infections continue to span all 27 barangays in the municipality. As of the Nov. 14 surveillance report released by the Municipal Health Office (MHO), the town recorded 21 new cases over the past week with zero additional fatalities. The slight decline brought the municipality’s cumulative tally to 488 cases, up from 467 the previous week. The death toll remained at two. READ: Agusan del Sur reels from dengue surge Health […]...
